description: This file defines the Stats class, which provides cached statistical methods for the Goteo project, such as total users, funded projects, and investment totals.

classes.name: Stats
classes.description: A utility class for caching and retrieving various platform statistics for Goteo, including user counts, funded projects, and investment summaries.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the Stats class with a specified cache name and TTL.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Magic method to allow dynamic method calls with caching, translating calls like ->totalUsers() to ->getTotalUsers().

methods.name: getTotalUsers
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of users in the system.

methods.name: getSucessfulPercentage
methods.description: Retrieves the percentage of successful projects.

methods.name: getTotalMoneyFunded
methods.description: Retrieves the total amount of money funded through investments.

methods.name: getTotalInvestAverage
methods.description: Retrieves the average investment per project.

methods.name: getMatchfundingRaised
methods.description: Calculates total funds raised through matchfunding calls and matchers.

methods.name: getMatchfundingSucessfulPercentage
methods.description: Retrieves the success percentage for matchfunded projects.

methods.name: getAdvisedProjects
methods.description: Retrieves projects that have been advised.

methods.name: getMatchfundingOwnersGender
methods.description: Retrieves gender distribution of matchfunding owners.

methods.name: getInvestTotals
methods.description: Returns total investment metrics based on provided filters.

methods.name: getInvestFees
methods.description: Calculates total, VAT, and subtotal fees for investments based on filters.

methods.name: getInvestAmounts
methods.description: Provides investment amounts grouped into ranges with their respective counts and percentages.

methods.name: getProjectTotals
methods.description: Returns totals for projects based on specified filters.
